title: Hypocrites speak light but think darkness
english: These hypocrites devise deeds worthy of darkness within, yet through their outward parts they bring forth words that seem to be full of light. For they are truly wolves who have put on sheep's clothing (Matthew 7:15). They wash only the outside of the cup and dish (Matthew 23:25), not knowing that unless the inside is cleansed, the outside cannot become clean.
translator_notes: Copy-text PG 10 Khazarzar Fragmentum in evangelium Matthaei. PD.
True OET; Pass A ≠ Pass B. Melito skipped; never Cyril Matthew densify.
orientation: Gregory is describing the hypocrite whose evil eye darkens the whole body, now detailing how such a person thinks dark deeds inwardly while speaking words that seem full of light.

title: The Savior convicts hypocrites with the darkness question
english: Therefore, clearly convicting these people, the Savior says: If the light that is in you is darkness, how great is the darkness?

title: If your seeming love is darkness, how much worse your open sins
english: That is, if the love that seems to you to be light is actually a work worthy of darkness because of the hypocrisy hidden in you, then how much worse are your open transgressions?
